# source: marginnote manual (marginnote.pdf, for marginnote.sty v1.4b), §1
# usage: \marginnote{text}[offset] sets a note in the margin without a float;
# here it is the kernel's margin note, ragged, the offset moving nothing.
body impl Text.\marginnote{A note.}
body impl Text.\marginnote{A note.}[2pt]
